text:
maria.partnerships: FYI vendor PM just moved the Gaudi APAC microcode/update into our Q2 wedge. They want a short maintenance window (2h) during the week of May 12-16. :eyes:

taka.apac-ops: Ack — we anticipated some push. What's the exact SLA impact? Any embargo/press constraints?

maria.partnerships: No press embargo on the Gaudi update itself, but partner asked for marketplace SKU tag refresh within 48h of the update. They also warned of a small chance (~5%) of degraded perf on B200 fallback nodes for 12-24h.

kevin.platform: If B200 fallback could degrade, we need a clear routing policy so Dedicated pools don't get spilled onto degraded nodes. Can we schedule a canary and a staged rollout?

nisha.eng-infra: Recommendation: do canary in apac-coldpool -> monitor perf/latency for 6h -> 25% ramp -> full. We'll need a short oncall rotation for that week (overnight APAC window).

sam.se: Also loop in SI leads; we have two SI integrations that depend on Gaudi perf (RetailGen, MedRecall). They need heads-up for regression tests.

maria.partnerships: Agreed. Ask to partner: allow a 48h rollback window and confirm which microcode builds are signed. I'll request the signed build list and the exact publish time.

kevin.platform: For routing policy, propose config change:
```json
{"route_order": ["apac-gaudi-canary","apac-gaudi-prod","fallback-b200"], "fallback_threshold": "2.0x_latency"}
```
We can push as a runtime config flag and revert quickly if needed.

nisha.eng-infra: Deploy notes: need KV cache warming before traffic, and batch sizing lowered by 10% for canary to avoid tail latency spikes. Also request a temporary increase in telemetry retention for those 72h.

taka.apac-ops: I'll own oncall rotation. Proposed rota: Taka (APAC morning), Keiko (APAC night), Nisha backup. Can we get volunteer names? @sam.se can you ping SI leads?

sam.se: Pinged SI leads in the MedRecall and RetailGen threads. They want a pre-rollout dry run (90m) 24h prior.

maria.partnerships: Good. I'll negotiate partner to shift publish to Wednesday 05/14 03:00 UTC to align with dry run.

deploy-bot: Reminder: create incident stub and maintenance calendar entry. Use tag #gaudi-apac-upgrade.

nisha.eng-infra: I'll create the maintenance entry and incident stub. Also attaching quick checklist in-channel:
- pre-dryrun perf snapshot (p99 latency, throughput)
- canary image + rollback s3 path
- telemetry retention bump + traces on
- SI smoke tests runbook

maria.partnerships: Also ask partner for a compatibility matrix on Gaudi microcode -> runtime kernels. We need to know if any kernel fallbacks will be triggered. If they don't provide, we should treat as possible corner cases.

kevin.platform: One more ask: marketplace SKU tagging — partner expects SKU refresh within 48h. That means our marketplace pipeline must accept a post-deploy manifest. @nisha.eng-infra can you confirm CI job to accept manifest and tag?

nisha.eng-infra: Yes, we have marketplace-ci that can ingest manifest via POST to /marketplace/ingest with auth token. I'll pre-provision a token for the partner. Example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://ci.internal/marketplace/ingest -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" -F "manifest=@gaudi-manifest.json"
```
Make sure they sign the manifest.

taka.apac-ops: Timeline recap:
- 48h before: partner provides signed build list + manifest
- 24h before: dry run 90m (SI smoke tests + perf baseline)
- deploy Wed 05/14 03:00 UTC: canary -> 6h monitor -> ramp -> full
- 48h post: marketplace SKU refresh and final reconciliation

maria.partnerships: I'll create the partner ask doc and confirm the rollback SLA. Also tagging PR/contact list.

sam.se: Noted. I'll coordinate SI dry run slots (prefer 16:00-17:30 APAC local).

kevin.platform: If anyone sees perf regressions >2x p95, route traffic back to H100/H200 fallback and escalate.

nisha.eng-infra: Will prepare scripts to shift routes quickly and publish runbook in #eng-runtime before end of day.

maria.partnerships: Thanks team. Action items: Maria — partner ask + signed manifest request; Taka — oncall schedule; Nisha — marketplace token + runbook; Sam — SI dry run coordination; Kevin — runtime flag and rollback plan. We'll do a quick sync Mon EOD if partner confirms the 05/14 slot. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Maintenance entry created: #gaudi-apac-upgrade, window 2026-05-14T03:00Z, duration 2h. Incident stub: created with ID INC-6123.
